behaviors.behavior: a same-PR --write that self-grandfathers a newly-unbound AC into the baseline is reported as growth vs. the parent commit
a stable/shrinking baseline, and the commit that first introduces the baseline file, are never reported as growth
a multi-commit push needs the push's own before-SHA, not bare HEAD~1, to see growth from an earlier commit in the push
an unresolvable --parent-sha (e.g. an all-zeros before on a new branch) fails open with a warning, distinct from a real parent that simply predates the baseline (silent bootstrap)
a genuine git-level read fault at the parent commit (path shadowed by a directory) is distinguished from absence and warns instead of silently bootstrapping
a non-UTF-8 byte in a historically-committed parent baseline never raises -- the growth check stays on the fail-open path
a --baseline path outside --project-root, and a corrupt/unparseable/wrong-shape parent baseline, all fail open with a warning
the CLI rejects --check-baseline-growth combined with --write, and surfaces growth-check warnings in the payload without blocking a clean run
the payload shape is unchanged (no baseline_grew_since_parent key) when --check-baseline-growth is omitted, so existing PR-time consumers see no diff

the ci.yml AC coverage ratchet step's trigger now covers pull_request AND push-to-main, its run command carries the exact --check-baseline-growth --parent-sha expression only on push, and both sibling gates (Keystone, Orphan AC binding) stay pull_request-only with unchanged read-only job permissions

surface_verification.justification: CI workflow + gate-script change (widen the AC coverage ratchet trigger to push, add a push-only baseline-growth auxiliary signal); no startable web/dev-server/CLI surface of its own to browser-verify -- verification is the unit test suite (real-git-repo fixtures) plus the CI YAML shape tests (F0).
